proposal.ruling_text: The item did not fail its criteria: all three criteria passed on every iteration. The stop occurred because the environment running the tenant-declared pytest commands lacked `jsonschema`, although the tenant's CI instruction explicitly installs that dependency. `cmd_build` correctly executes the manifest's selected-test and whole-tree commands in the tenant's current environment; it does not provision tenant test dependencies. Re-run the build in the tenant's provisioned test environment. This remains `unclassed`: no existing stop class names a missing tenant runtime dependency, and the incident does not establish a defect in the proposed item or Attavo's build mechanism.
